content.user_title: Create an Alien Flora Research Chapter
content.value_statement: Writing a believable science-fiction research scene requires consistent character voice, discoveries, and danger. This guide provides a five-stage interactive chapter for Stella’s alien-plant expedition.
actual_capabilities: Structures a five-stage alien-botany story from curiosity through ecological insight.
Offers player choices for luminous plants, giant trees, fruits, and ground-level plants.
Supplies fictional scientific observations and resource discoveries for Stella’s character.
Includes branching hazard scenes involving a carnivorous plant or an unsafe fruit.
Defines three possible chapter endings for continued story development.
limitations: The material is a fictional writing guide, not a real botany or survival reference.
It does not provide medically safe advice about consuming unknown plants or treating poisoning.
The examples are primarily written in Chinese with mixed English phrases.
It covers one chapter and does not implement a game system or persistent state.

use_cases.title: Write a roleplay chapter
use_cases.description: Use the staged outline to lead a player through a science-fiction plant research expedition.

use_cases.title: Develop a character scene
use_cases.description: Use Stella’s observations and reactions to write a scientist character facing curiosity and danger.

use_cases.title: Plan connected story arcs
use_cases.description: Use the ending branches and recommended chapters to connect this scene to later adventures.

prompt_templates.title: Start the chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Studying Alien Flora guide to open the chapter. Present Stella’s camp, her research kit, and four plant categories for my choice.

prompt_templates.title: Explore luminous plants
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the alien flora chapter with the luminous-plant branch. Keep Stella curious, careful, and scientifically observant.

prompt_templates.title: Add a safe dramatic hazard
prompt_templates.prompt: Write the carnivorous-plant encounter from the guide. Keep the danger fictional and have Stella retreat, observe, and mark the area.

prompt_templates.title: Build a branching conclusion
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a conclusion for this alien flora chapter using the guide. Include field notes, one useful fictional resource, and a choice between the three endings.

output_examples.input: Start a research scene about luminous alien plants.
output: Stella prepares a microscope and spectrum analyzer beside the camp.
She asks the player whether to collect a glowing leaf or observe its light pattern first.

output_examples.input: Conclude the expedition after a dangerous discovery.
output: Stella records the hazard zone and stores carefully labeled observations.
The chapter ends with a clue that the plant flashes may be a form of communication.

best_practices: State that all alien biology and treatments are fictional when expanding the scenes.
Give the player meaningful choices before advancing each story stage.
Balance scientific observations with cautious decisions and clear consequences.
anti_patterns: Do not present fictional plant safety or medical actions as real-world guidance.
Do not remove player choice by resolving every discovery automatically.
Do not make hazards fatal or graphic when the chapter calls for moderate tension.

faq.question: What does this skill help write?
faq.answer: It helps write an interactive science-fiction chapter about researching alien plants.

faq.question: Is the content a real science guide?
faq.answer: No. It is fictional narrative material and should not be used for real botany, survival, or medical decisions.

faq.question: Which language does it use?
faq.answer: The source is primarily Chinese and includes mixed English phrases.

faq.question: Can I choose different research paths?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide includes choices for luminous plants, fruits, giant trees, and ground-level plants.

faq.question: Does it include danger?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes fictional, moderate-risk encounters that emphasize observation and caution.

faq.question: Can I connect it to another chapter?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide suggests follow-up chapters about cooking, science, ruins, and alien encounters.
